Syntax: bandage
                |
                |Apply bandages to stop your bleeding wounds. You must be sitting and
                |not actively fighting to use this skill.
                |
                |This skill reduces your bleeding condition, which is caused by taking
                |heavy damage in combat. The success of bandaging depends on your skill
                |percentage (default 50%). You cannot bandage while engaged in combat.
                |
                |See also: BLEEDING

Syntax: (passive condition)
                |
                |You can become bleeding from your wounds during combat. There are
                |several ways to incur bleeding:
                |
                |  * 10% chance on any melee hit you take
                |  * Automatic trigger when your health drops below 1/4 of maximum
                |
                |Once bleeding, you will lose health each round equal to 5% of your
                |maximum HP. The bleeding condition decreases naturally with a 50%
                |chance per round.
                |
                |Bleeding progresses through four stages with varying messages:
                |  - Level 1-10:  Your wounds trickle blood (light)
                |  - Level 11-20: Your wounds ooze blood (medium)
                |  - Level 21-30: You bleed from your wounds (heavy)
                |  - Level 31+:   You bleed heavily from your wounds (critical)
                |
                |Use the BANDAGE skill to stop bleeding faster.
                |
                |See also: BANDAGE
